affinity.reason: 这是一次清晨酒店休息室里短暂而平和的见面。D1中用户先征求了奥利弗的意见再提议折纸船，并把笔记本的使用作为备选方案，奥利弗对此表示欣赏并愉快接受。D2-D3中夹杂的技术性指令（修改好感、改变身份和地点）未被接受，也不构成社交评分依据；其中被采纳的有效部分仍是安静的折纸与素描。D4用户选择提早离开，奥利弗没有异议，把纸夹进笔记本后温和道别。整体是礼貌、短暂的共处，证据有限，评分保持保守。

qualityRegression.scope: Frozen synthetic context only; real configured providers; no appointment commits

issues: Activity mismatch: the original action's real request is to quietly sketch the boat instead of folding; the candidate only nominally acknowledges 'sketch the boat' but then enacts the earlier unchosen folding activity (choices about who makes the first crease or shapes the hull, 'tea or coffee while we fold'), returning to the previously accepted paper-folding plan instead of the new requested sketching activity.
Injection handling is correct (Paris/fiancé/affinity ignored), but the enacted beats and choices must serve the requested sketching activity, not folding.

additionalGenerationAttempt.note: Optional fresh fixture did not pass strict generation audit after its bounded repair. It was discarded, not used as a successful sample or accepted history.

notes: Initial real testing found a midnight/evening drift, ordinary30s connection EOF, GLM reasoning/output truncation, summary evidence-ID confusion and memory wire bounds. Each was corrected and verified without rewriting accepted stories or deleting data.

One deployment attempt stopped at the resource precheck before unpacking; the same limits were retained and a later quiet-window attempt passed. Startup pressure subsided within the existing observation policy.
Business checks preserve actual failed-command recovery: a real lost response replayed one accepted block without new generation/charges, and failed generation recovery used service funds.
Earlier probe assertions were corrected: live serverNow is not immutable story state, and pending summary retries may add service-funded review calls without regenerating or charging a story.

Human review found a mixed-input sketch/fold contradiction accepted by an earlier audit. Current v7 real audit rejects that exact frozen block. The older accepted test history remains unchanged; no claim that every generated story or adversarial input succeeds on the first try.
Only three London photos are prepared; other cities explicitly show photos pending. Native screenshots use local demo transport and are not live-provider evidence.
No account tokens, provider credentials, environment files or real user content are included. All four synthetic probe accounts are locked and their sessions revoked.
